## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/speckit-helper.sh:508-511` — `plan-review-round` sources its lib with `|| die`; a new subcommand copies it.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:564` — verdict evidence `maxLength 500`: the `BLOCKING` line must fit (spec D8).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:199,205` — `orchestrate.tiers.verify` default `fable`, must rank ≥ implement: the
  verify run's reviewer tier is `fable` by default, so the cross-tier finder is `opus` by default.
- `agents/code-reviewer.md:2` — the agent's pinned tier; a spawn's `model:` override picks the other tier (the arena
  does the same for `truth-scout`, `commands/hef.plan.md` step 2 of the Arena).
- `tests/smoke.sh:6937-6950` — every `evals/*/case.yaml` must have schema_version 1.x, name, `execution.prompt`,
  graders with a real type.
- `tests/smoke.sh:2834` — no concrete model id in `hooks/ commands/ evals/ agents/`.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- A lib per feature sourced by a helper subcommand (`plan-review-lib.sh`, `spec-root-lib.sh` `speckit-helper.sh:50-51`).
- Helpers fail loudly: non-zero exit with the offending value (constitution 5).
- Feature tests live in `tests/smoke-<feature>.sh`, sourced at the end of `tests/smoke.sh`, each guard mutation-tested
  (constitution 3; e.g. `tests/smoke-rework.sh`).
- Eval scaffolds build a git repo in the empty workspace; cases with a long budget raise `max_turns`/`timeout_seconds`
  (`plan-arena-attributes-claims`: 30 turns, 900 s — `evals/README.md`).
- CHANGELOG entries go under `[Unreleased]` (`tests/smoke-changelog-check.sh`).

## Replay corpus — the rejected commits (from `git log` and the ledger verdicts' `at`)

The verdicts carry no SHA; the rejected commit is the item branch's newest commit before the verdict's `at`.
Diff base = the branch's last merge of main.

Item first rejected commits: HEF-22 `ad63db8`, HEF-25 `ddc4130`, HEF-31 `6707703`. Some later defects were
introduced by an earlier round's fix (e.g. D22-4/D22-5 by `f95e13b`/`772239f`, D25-3 by `b615d3f`, D25-4 by
`fe2e3cb`, D31-4/D31-5 touch code added by `4e71a78`), so which defects are *present* at the first commit is
established per defect during implementation (the defect's reproduction run at the first commit) and recorded in
the item case — never assumed.

Spec folders at those commits: `forge-setup` (HEF-22), `run-survival` (HEF-25), `merge-forward` (HEF-31); a
scaffold branch `feature/<spec>` makes `/hefesto:hef.review` resolve the spec from the branch.
